sentences.en: The role of the placenta is to nourish the foetus.
sentences.zh: 胎盘的作用是滋养胎儿。

sentences.en: We know that even foetuses still in the womb of their mothers touch their faces.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，即使还在母亲子宫中的胎儿也会触碰自己的脸。

sentences.en: The foetus was positioned head-down for an easier delivery.
sentences.zh: 胎儿是头朝下的位置，这样分娩会更容易。
